_comment: Per-boss fall commentary. trigger 'boss_<biome>'. Narrator + that realm's god. Modal beats, played in sequence by the dialogue queue.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: The Hydra of Lerna lies still — its many heads silenced at last.

entries.speaker: greece_zeus
lines: The Hydra, dead? Even Olympus did not foresee that. Well struck, soul.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: Rangda is unmade. The demon queen's curse lifts from this realm.

entries.speaker: bali_acintya
lines: Balance returns by your hand. The cycle turns cleaner now.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: Apophis, the chaos serpent, is undone. The Duat steadies.

entries.speaker: egypt_osiris
lines: The serpent devours the sun no more. You have my gratitude, traveler.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: Fenrir falls, its chains scattered. Helheim trembles at your name.

entries.speaker: norse_odin
lines: The wolf felled before Ragnarok. The runes did not foresee you, mortal.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: Orochi's eight heads are severed. Yomi falls quiet.

entries.speaker: japan_amaterasu
lines: Orochi's shadow lifts. My light reaches even into Yomi now.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: Cipactli, the devourer, is slain. Mictlan bows before you.

entries.speaker: aztec_mictlantecuhtli
lines: The devourer falls — and even I, lord of Mictlan, take note of you.
